title: Momcozy Smart WiFi Baby Monitor with Camera and Audio,5" 1080P & Wall Mount
bullets: Choose Between WiFi or Non-wifi Connections to Check on Baby Anywhere, Anytime: Use the dedicated BM04 baby monitor parent unit for reliable monitoring at home, or check the live feed via the Momcozy app while you're on the go. Advanced encryption ensures your baby monitor video is private and secure, so you can focus on your little one with peace of mind. Note: Pairing via Wi-Fi supports only 2.4GHz Wi-Fi networks.

Danger Zone Alert for Added Safety: Stay one step ahead with instant app notifications when your baby leaves a designated safe area. With this wifi baby monitor, you'll be alerted immediately so you can respond and keep them safe without delay.

Smart Motion Detection for Extra Assurance: Real-time motion alerts via APP notify you of your baby's movements, including potential dangers like a covered face or face-down sleeping. This baby video monitor keeps you informed and confident your baby is safe. (Motion Alerts Notifications Appear Only in the APP)

Shared Video Access to Enhance Family Bonds: Bring loved ones closer by sharing video access with up to 20 family members. With the baby monitor camera, they can watch your baby grow and celebrate milestones, even from afar.

Auto Video Recording for Precious Memories: Never miss a moment! The video monitor baby camera offers continuous or motion-activated recording to capture every milestone. With just a tap or press, you can also take photos or record videos manually using the baby monitor with app.

TIPS: Smart Baby Monitor Installation Guidelines: 1) Crib Mounting Height Requirement: Ensure the camera is positioned at least 0.6m (24 inches) above the baby. If placed too low, the camera’s focal length may misalign, causing a blurry image. 2) Wall or Floor Stand Mounting Distance Limit: Keep the camera within 5m (16 feet) of the crib horizontally. Beyond this range, the infrared night vision won’t provide sufficient lighting, making it difficult to see the baby’s face clearly in the dark.
